title: Greet and introduce yourself
bridge: Afaan Espanii keessatti, inni ‘Hola’ kana ‘Buenos días’ jedhamu godhamee, ‘Me llamo...’ kana ‘Soy...’ jedhamu kenname. Afaan Ingilizii keessattis dubbii kan qindeessuun barbaachisaa ta’ee jira. ‘Hello’ kana ‘Good morning’ jedhamu godhamee, ‘My name is...’ kana ‘I am...’ jedhamu kenname. Fakkeenya uumamuu ‘I am called...’ jedhu kan dandeessuudha (haa ta’u malee, barbaachisaa adabii akkamii ta’eefi godhamuun sii hin qabne). Akkasumas, afaan Ingilizii keessatti du’aa kennuuf ‘to be’ jedhamu afaan qabaachuun barbaachisuu dha. ‘What is your name?’ (hin ‘How are you called?’ jechuu).
rule: Godhamu: ‘Hello’ (Hola), ‘Hi’ (haa ta’eefi godhamu), ‘Good morning’ (Buenos días), ‘Good afternoon’ (Buenas tardes), ‘Good evening’ (Buenas noches irratti argamu). Kennamu: ‘My name is...’ (Me llamo...) kana ‘I am...’ (Soy...). Du’aa kennu: ‘What is your name?’ (¿Cómo te llamas?). Godhamu dhaabachu: ‘Nice to meet you’ (Encantado/a de conocerte) kana ‘Nice to meet you too’. Galaana: ‘Goodbye’, ‘Bye’, ‘See you later’.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Espanii keessatti ‘Me llamo Anna’ jedhamu godhamu, garuu afaan Ingilizii keessatti kennamuu ‘My name is...’ kana ‘I am...’ jechuu adaa ta’eefi jira. ‘I am called’ jedhu akkamii ta’eefi godhamuun sii hin qabne.

title: Give personal information (age, nationality, profession)
bridge: Afaan Espanii keessatti, dubbiin gurraacha godhi ‘Tengo 25 años’ (verbo ‘tener’ kan hin jiru) jedhaniif kennu; Afaan Ingilizii keessatti garuu, ‘I am 25 years old’ (verbo ‘to be’ kan hin jiru) jedhaniif kennu. Dubbiin mootichiis garuu, ‘Soy español’ (qoodi hin jiru) jedhaniif kennu; Afaan Ingilizii keessatti garuu, ‘I am Spanish’ (qoodi hin jiru) jedhaniif kennu. Dubbiin deebii keessatti, Afaan Espanii keessatti ‘Soy profesor’ (qoodi hin jiru) jedhaniif kennu; Afaan Ingilizii keessatti garuu qoodi ‘a’ kana ‘an’ irraa ta’u baruu dha: ‘I am a teacher’.
rule: Dubbi gurraacha: ‘I am [number] years old’ (misola: I am 25 years old). Dubbi mootichiis: ‘I am [nationality]’ (misola: I am Spanish, I am Mexican). Dubbi deebii: ‘I am a/an [profession]’ (misola: I am a doctor, I am an engineer). Dubbatanii: ‘How old are you?’ (Gurraacha keessan tokko qofa?), ‘Where are you from?’ (Keessan dhaabbataa ta’e?), ‘What do you do?’ (Haala qaban taatee?) kana ‘What is your job?’.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Espanii keessatti, dubbi gurraacha godhi ‘Tengo 25 años’ jedhaniif kennu; Afaan Ingilizii keessatti garuu verbo ‘to be’ hin jiru. Kana hin salphaa ta’e malee, Afaan Espanii dubbatan keessan tokko qaban.

examples.note: Verbo ‘to be’ dubbi gurraacha keessatti kennu.
Qoodi dubbi mootichiis keessatti hin jiru.
Qoodi ‘a’ kana ‘an’ dubbi deebii keessatti kennu.

title: Describe objects and people (basic)
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, mana qabxii fi namoota dubbifama qabxichaa baafachuu qabna. Adjectives (qabxichi) namni (noun) hin baafne; ‘mana qoricha’, ‘namni dheessaa’. Afaan Ingilizitti, adjective (qabxicha) namni (noun) hin baafne; ‘a red car’, ‘a tall girl’. ‘To be’ kan verbicha mana qabxichi dubbifama fi ‘have got’ kan verbicha mana qabxichi dubbifama qabna (She is tall) fi (She has got blue eyes).
rule: Dubbifama: 1) Adjectives + noun (a big house). 2) Subject + ‘to be’ + adjective (The house is big). 3) Subject + ‘have/has got’ + qabxicha (She has got long hair). Adjectives dubbifama: big (godha), small (hojii), tall (dheessa), short (hojii), beautiful (adhuun), old (daandii), young (ilboo), fast (dhaabbataa), slow (daqii).

common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispaaniitti, adjective (qabxicha) namni (noun) baafne (‘un coche rojo’), afaan Ingilizitti adjective (qabxicha) namni (noun) hin baafne (‘a red car’). Kana qorichaa Afaan Ispaanii dubbiftan qorichaa akkan akkamummuu danda’a.

examples.note: ‘To be’ kan verbicha mana qabxichi dubbifama qabna.
‘Have got’ kan verbicha mana qabxichi dubbifama qabna.

examples.original: My brother is young and he has got green eyes.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbrʌðə ɪz jʌŋ ænd hiː hæz ɡɒt ɡriːn aɪz/
examples.translation: Walfii keessan ilboo fi qoricha isaaniif godha.
examples.note: ‘To be’ fi ‘have got’ kan verbicha mana qabxichi dubbifama qixxiisaa.

title: Talk about daily routines
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, haala dhaabbataa malee barrachuu kan danda'u argachuu dha. Afaan Ispeenichii keessattis, haala dhaabbataa malee barrachuu kan danda'u argachuu dha. Guyyaa lamaanii keessatti, Afaan Ingilizii keessatti 'at' saatiin (at 7 o'clock), 'in' guyyaa (in the morning) fi 'on' guyyaa (on Monday) kan barbaadu. Adverb qajeelfama 'always', 'usually', 'sometimes' kana verb haasa'aa kennu.
rule: Haala dhaabbataa malee barrachuu: 1) Presente simple (I get up, she works) ol barrachuu. 2) Adverb qajeelfama: 'at' + saatiin (at 8 am), 'in' + guyyaa (in the morning), 'on' + guyyaa (on Friday). 3) Adverb qajeelfama verb haasa'aa kennu (I always eat breakfast). 4) Galataa: 'What time do you get up?' ama 'When do you have lunch?'.

concept_examples.text: She usually has breakfast at 8 am.
concept_examples.translation: Isa baay'ee saatiin 8 guyyaa tokkorratti dubbifama.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈjuːʒuəli hæz ˈbrekfəst æt eɪt æm/

concept_examples.text: We go to work at 9 in the morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ɡəʊ tə wɜːk æt naɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: What time do you have dinner?

common_error.wrong: I am eating breakfast every morning.
common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispeenichii keessatti, haala dhaabbataa malee barrachuu kan danda'u argachuu dha ('estoy desayunando cada mañana'), laakin Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, haala dhaabbataa malee barrachuu kan danda'u argachuu dha, presente continuo hin kennu.

examples.note: Verb presente simple haala dhaabbataa malee barrachuu.

examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv lʌntʃ æt wʌn piː em/

examples.original: What time do you go to bed?
examples.phonetic: /wɒt taɪm duː juː ɡəʊ tə bed/

title: Express likes and dislikes (I like / Aanandii keessan dubbatan)
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffii keessummaa, haala dhaabbolessuun barbaachisaa ‘like’ kan itti fayyadama: ‘I like pizza’. Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, barbaachisaa ‘gustar’ kan itti fayyadama: ‘Me gusta la pizza’ (dhaabbolaa ‘La pizza me gusta a mí’). Deebii tokko tokkoon barbaachisaa ‘like’ qabuu hin jiru; barbaachisaa ‘gustar’ gara suuraa hojii fayyadamaa malee, ‘like’ gara suuraa hojii fayyadamaa ta’ee. Haala dhaabbataa akka ta’e jedhu, ‘I don’t like’ (no me gusta) jedhaa ta’u malee.
rule: Haala dhaabbolessuun barbaachisaa: 1) Haalaa isaanii: I/you/we/they like + suuraa (I like coffee). He/she/it likes + suuraa (She likes coffee). 2) Haalaa hin isaanii: I/you/we/they don’t like (I don’t like tea). He/she/it doesn’t like (He doesn’t like tea). 3) Galataa: Do you like...? (¿Te gusta...?), Does she like...? (¿Le gusta a ella...?). 4) Haalaa guutummaa: 'I like it very much' (Me gusta mucho) kana malee 'I really like it' (Me gusta mucho).

concept_examples.translation: No nos gusta la comida rápida.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, barbaachisaa ‘mucho’ gara qabxii barbaachisaa fayyadamaa ta’ee. Afaan Ingiliffii keessummaa, ‘very much’ gara qabxii salaan fayyadamaa ta’ee. Kanarraa, barbaachisaa fi suuraa hin kennamuu ‘very much’ fayyadamuudhaaf isaanii akkasuma hin taane.

examples.translation: A él le gusta el fútbol.
examples.note: Barbaachisaa -s gara qabxii barbaachisaa fayyadamaa ta’ee.

examples.translation: A ella no le gusta el café.
examples.note: ‘Doesn’t’ fi barbaachisaa hojii isaa fayyadamaa ta’ee.
Galataa ‘do’ fi suuraa hojii isaa fayyadamaa ta’ee.

title: Ask for and give prices
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, dubbi fi’izaa ga’uu kan dhiisuu ‘How much is it?’ (dhugaa) kana ‘How much are they?’ (sadii) jechuudha. ‘How much does it cost?’ (dubbi fi’izaa ga’uu) ifa malee barbaachisa. Ayyaana tokko qofa ‘to be’ kana ‘cost’ fi ‘does’ dubbatanii akkan godhataniif adabbi’aa jiraatanii wajjin tokko qaba. Fi’izaa ga’uudhaan ‘It is [tiro] dollars/euros’ kana ‘It costs [tiro].’ jechuudha.
rule: Dubbi fi’izaa ga’uu: 1) ‘How much is it?’ (dhugaa) kana ‘How much are they?’ (sadii). 2) ‘How much does it cost?’. 3) ‘How much is the T-shirt?’. Fi’izaa ga’uudhaan ‘It is 25 dollars’ kana ‘It costs 25 dollars’ jechuudha. Dubbatan, ‘to be’ kana ‘does’ + ‘cost’ akkan godhu barbaadaa.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti ‘¿Cuánto cuesta?’ jedhanii akkasuma hin qabnu. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘cost’ jedhamtu ‘does’ dubbatan barbaachisa. Kana hunda afaan Ispaanii irra deebii akkan godhuu danda’a.

examples.original: How much does the bag cost?

title: Indicate location of places
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, mana dhaabbataa biraa qabdu kanarraa ‘It is on the street...’, ‘It is next to the bank’, ‘It is near the station’ jedhama. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, ‘on’, ‘in’, ‘at’, ‘next to’, ‘near’, ‘opposite’, ‘behind’, ‘in front of’ jedhamu prepositions of place hin kennu. Akkasumas, ‘to be’ jedhamu verb hin kennu (It is...).
rule: Dhaabbata biraa qabduu kanarraa: 1) ‘to be’ jedhamu verb kennu (The bank is...). 2) Prepositions of place: ‘on’ (dhaabbataa biraa qabdu), ‘in’ (seenaa biraa qabdu), ‘at’ (point specific qabdu), ‘next to’ (hoji qabdu), ‘near’ (dhiheessu qabdu), ‘opposite’ (akakaa’i qabdu), ‘behind’ (dhiheessu qabdu), ‘in front of’ (ol qabdu). 3) Galchiisuu kanarraa: ‘Where is the...?’ (Mana dhaabbataa biraa qabdu?) ama ‘Is there a... near here?’ (Mana dhiheessu qabdu?)

concept_examples.text: The supermarket is near the park.
The school is next to the church.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə skuːl ɪz nekst tə ðə tʃɜːtʃ/

concept_examples.text: The pharmacy is on Main Street.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Qaraa keessatti ‘Está en la esquina’ jedhama fi warri subject hin qabne. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, subject ‘It’ ama ‘He/She’ barbaachisaa qaba. Akkasumas, ‘en la esquina’ jedhamu ‘on the corner’ (hordofu ‘in the corner’) jedhama yoo ta’e, dhaabbataa biraa qabduu kan qabna.

examples.original: The cat is in the garden.
examples.note: ‘In’ jedhamu seenaa biraa qabduu kan qabna.

levels.label: Location with 'next to'
levels.translation: Dhaabbata biraa qabduu ‘next to’ hin kennamne

examples.original: The restaurant is next to the hotel.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈrestrɒnt ɪz nekst tə ðə həʊˈtel/
examples.note: ‘Next to’ jedhamu hoji qabduu kan qabna.

levels.label: Location with 'near' and 'opposite'
levels.translation: Dhaabbata biraa qabduu ‘near’ fi ‘opposite’ hin kennamne

examples.original: The bank is opposite the park.
